title: TIE/rp reaper (Star Wars: Squadrons)

sources.title: STAR WARS: Squadrons PC text manual (EA accessibility resources)

intro: The TIE reaper in Star Wars: Squadrons is the Empire's support craft: it repairs and resupplies friends and disturbs enemies. Button 7 does power conversion.

panels.name: TIE/rp reaper: class and loadout
panels.text: This lists the TIE reaper's class and its parts as the hangar shows them.
panels.context: All other controls work as in every Squadrons ship; the parts (components) can be changed in the hangar before a battle.

controls.name: Pilot seat
controls.text: The TIE reaper has a single-seat cockpit: one pilot and no crew.
controls.context: The pilot flies alone and does every job: flying, shooting, power and team messages.

controls.name: Class: support (Imperial)
controls.text: The TIE reaper is the Empire's support ship that helps the team.
controls.context: The class decides the ship's role in a battle and which components the hangar offers for it.

controls.name: Laser cannons
controls.text: The TIE reaper's forward laser cannons fire as the primary weapon.
controls.context: They fire with the trigger; more weapon power on the hat lets them fire longer.

controls.name: Support auxiliaries
controls.text: Repair and resupply components sit on the TIE reaper's auxiliary buttons.
controls.context: With them the reaper pilot fixes squadmates and refills their equipment during the battle.

controls.name: Auxiliaries (left and right)
controls.text: The TIE reaper carries two auxiliary components: the left one on button 3, the right one on button 4.
controls.context: Head buttons 3 and 4 on the stick use them; the auxiliary status display shows their cooldown.

controls.name: Countermeasures
controls.text: The TIE reaper's countermeasure component sits on head button 6 of the stick.
controls.context: Head button 6 fires it; it is the answer to a missile warning.

controls.name: Button 7: power conversion
controls.text: On this Imperial ship base button 7 is power conversion: it moves power between the lasers and the engines.
controls.context: Imperial ships have no shield focus; power conversion gives them speed or firepower when needed.
